description.value:
When you land a weapon attack against a creature you're hidden from, you can turn that hit into a critical hit. If the strike drops the target to 0 hit points, other nearby enemies don't automatically notice you: contest a Dexterity (Stealth) check against each one's Wisdom (Perception), and you stay hidden from any who lose. If the attack would already let you roll a Stealth check to remain hidden, you instead gain advantage on that check.

You can use this feature once, gaining an additional use at 9th level and again at 17th level. All uses return after a long rest.
